title: Nautical Festival | Fête nautique
medium: Hand Signed and Numbered Aquatint in Colours on Arches Wove Paper

events.n: etched and aquatinted after Dufy's maquette, with Dufy's collaboration and supervision
events.q: This particular work was etched and aquatinted on the plate by Jacques Villon after the specially prepared maquette by Dufy and with Dufy’s collaboration and supervision.
The work was published by Galerie Bernheim Jeune, Paris in 1928.
